description: This file contains server and application logic for handling logs, cache invalidation, version checking, and testing site URL and email configurations within the Mattermost server, specifically related to the 'admin' functionalities in the 'channels/app' package.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: Represents the server component handling logs, cache, and cluster info.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Represents the application layer providing log querying, cache invalidation, version info, and testing functions.

methods.name: GetLogs
methods.description: Retrieves logs from the server, including cluster info if enabled.

methods.name: QueryLogs
methods.description: Queries logs with filtering options, combining local and cluster logs.

methods.name: GetLogsSkipSend
methods.description: Retrieves logs without sending notifications, for internal use.

methods.name: InvalidateAllCachesSkipSend
methods.description: Invalidates all caches without sending notifications.

methods.name: RecycleDatabaseConnection
methods.description: Recycles database connections by setting a max lifetime.

methods.name: TestSiteURL
methods.description: Tests connectivity to a site URL by pinging the system endpoint.

methods.name: TestEmail
methods.description: Tests SMTP email configuration by sending a test email.

methods.name: GetLatestVersion
methods.description: Fetches the latest version info from a URL, with caching.

methods.name: clearLatestVersionCache
methods.description: Clears the cached latest version info.
